info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Branch Network Management API
info.description: The Branch Network Management API offers businesses a streamlined way to access and manage network information related to banking branches. This API allows users to retrieve specific details about branch network configurations and operations, enabling enhanced decision-making and operational efficiency. Typical consumers include banking institutions and network administrators looking to optimize their branch services or troubleshoot network-related issues. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate branch network data into their applications, ensuring better service delivery and customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific branch network management resource identified by its unique resource ID (RES-100045). Use this to get insights into the branch's network configuration and status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to the branch network management operations for a specific channel. Ensure that the request body adheres to the schema specified to properly format the data being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested data.
